title: Store Terraform Remote State in S3 with Locking
title_es: Almacenar Terraform Remote State en S3 con Bloqueo
description: Bootstrap and backend configuration for Terraform remote state on S3 with native lockfile locking, encryption, versioning, public access block, and per-environment state isolation.
description_es: Configuración de bootstrap y backend para Terraform remote state en S3 con locking nativo por lockfile, cifrado, versionado, acceso público bloqueado y aislamiento de state por entorno.
